scripts.dev:app: npm run build:domain && npm run build:server-shared && npm run -w @praxis-flow/app dev
scripts.dev:sandbox: npm run build:server-shared && npm run -w @praxis-flow/sandbox dev
scripts.build:app: npm run build:domain && npm run build:server-shared && npm run build:flow-core && npm run -w @praxis-flow/app build && node scripts/copy-ui-static.mjs
scripts.build: npm run build:domain && npm run build:server-shared && npm run build:ui && npm run build:app
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @praxis-flow/domain -w @praxis-flow/server-shared -w @praxis-flow/flow-core -w @praxis-flow/app -w @praxis-flow/sandbox -w @praxis-flow/ui -w @praxis-flow/setup -w @praxis-flow/manager && npm run lint:css
scripts.test: npm run build:domain && npm run build:server-shared && npm run test:scripts && npm run test -w @praxis-flow/domain && npm run test -w @praxis-flow/server-shared && npm run test -w @praxis-flow/setup && npm run test -w @praxis-flow/sandbox && npm run test -w @praxis-flow/manager && npm run test -w @praxis-flow/app && npm run test -w @praxis-flow/ui

scripts.check:drift: node ./scripts/check-topic-icon-ids.mjs && node ./scripts/check-openapi-types-sync.mjs && node ./scripts/check-app-openapi-types-sync.mjs && node ./scripts/check-bundle-sync.mjs && node ./scripts/check-fastify-schemas-sync.mjs && node ./scripts/check-openapi-route-sync.mjs && node ./scripts/check-auth-route-rules.mjs
scripts.typecheck:only: npm run build:domain && npm run build:server-shared && npm run -ws typecheck && npm run check:drift
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck:only && npm run test && npm run build:ui && node scripts/copy-ui-static.mjs && npm run check:ui-bundle-secrets
scripts.generate:api: npm run bundle:openapi && npm run generate:api-schemas && npm run generate:app-openapi-types && npm run generate:openapi-types
